title: Windows Defender / Antivirus Blocking
description: Windows Defender or 3rd party antivirus flags or deletes the loader immediately.
solution:
1. Open Windows Security -> Virus & threat protection.
2. Click 'Manage settings' under Virus & threat protection settings.
3. Turn off Real-time protection, or scroll down to 'Exclusions' and add your Downloads/game folder as an exclusion.

title: Network Error / Could Not Establish Connection
description: The loader cannot establish a connection, preventing you from continuing or downloading the required files.
solution:
1. Try connecting to a VPN of your choice.
2. Recommended VPNs are Cloudflare WARP or Proton VPN.
3. Connect to the VPN and restart the loader.
4. Try downloading or continuing again.

title: Features Not Visible In-Game
description: The loader starts successfully and features are enabled, but nothing appears on your screen in-game.
solution: Disable all third-party overlays that may interfere with the loader, including Discord Overlay, AMD Overlay, NVIDIA Overlay, and MSI Afterburner/RivaTuner. Restart the game and loader after disabling them.

title: Driver Not Compatible
description: You launch the loader and receive a 'Driver Not Compatible' error. The loader may also restart before displaying this message.
solution: Disable all Core Isolation settings in Windows Security, then restart your PC and launch the loader again.
